title: Ship Production-Grade Next.js Apps at Scale
description: An enterprise-ready Next.js 16 foundation engineered with type-safe routing, native edge proxying, internationalization, accessible UI primitives, and modular plugin architecture.

proxy.title: Next.js 16 Proxy Architecture
proxy.description: Edge-ready request interceptor with native src/proxy.ts, React 19 Server Components, and Turbopack bundler.

i18n.title: Type-Safe Internationalization
i18n.description: Built-in multi-language routing and message translations with next-intl and seamless RTL support.

styling.title: Design System & Dark Mode
styling.description: Tailwind CSS paired with Radix UI accessible primitives and instant dark/light theme switching.

plugins.title: Modular Plugin Ecosystem
plugins.description: Easily compose databases (Drizzle/Prisma), Auth (Better Auth), tRPC, and Vercel AI SDK on demand.
